Counter that this redefines the question; if official/full-name usage counts, 2011 becomes incoherent and 2010 becomes arguable, but that answers a different question. Unresolved verification:
1. Exact 2015 Enugu/South-East source, date, headline, and quote.
2. True date of the media-chat quote: January 2014 vs 31 March 2013.
3. Whether 2010 oaths or 2011 INEC/inauguration materials actually used “Goodluck Ebele Azikiwe Jonathan” versus shortened “Goodluck Ebele Jonathan.”
